name: @mahjong-sandbox/sdk
description: Typed, validated Rust mahjong engine for browsers, Node.js and AI experiments

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.unit-tests.json && node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/validation.test.mjs tests/logs.test.mjs tests/mjai.test.mjs tests/mjai-annotated.test.mjs
